serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You give her 400 dollars.
You: Sure, I owe you that much.
#Annalie.Eyes.smileClosed+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Lady Annalie: Just so you know. Never again ask me to do anything like that, ok?
You: S-Sure…
#Annalie.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Anyway, the guy has some serious issues. Either he was always like that and the girl got sick of it or she’s a literal demon and broke him.
You: That bad?
Lady Annalie: I told him to go and see a therapist and he agreed quite easily. Couldn’t you have asked him to do it?
You: Sorry, it didn’t cross my mind.
Lady Annalie: Eh, whatever. What’s done is done.
Lady Annalie: With that out of the way. Do you want to buy something? 
You: Sure, I can look around.
